title: Creative Workshop for Kids / Taller Creativo para Niños
description:
Date: Thursday, March 19, 2026
Time: 4:00pm - 5:00pm
Location: PGML-Biblioteca Criolla

POTATO PRESS MAGIC Celebrate the joy of making in this hands-on printmaking workshop for kids. Using potatoes as playful printing tools, we’ll explore shapes, textures, patterns, and colors in ways that engage the senses and spark curiosity. The process is joyful, tactile, and wonderfully absorbing – carving, stamping, layering, and experimenting together, children will strengthen fine motor skills, practice creative problem-solving, and enjoy the fun of creating side-by-side with others. Every child will go home with their own vibrant artwork, wearable piece, or special gift — a creative and unique reminder of their imagination at work.

MAGIA CON SELLOS DE PAPA

Celebra la alegría de crear en este taller para niños. Con papas como herramientas de impresión, exploraremos formas, texturas y colores que activan los sentidos y despiertan la curiosidad. Tallando, estampando y experimentando, los niños fortalecerán su motricidad fina y su creatividad mientras se divierten en grupo. Cada participante se llevará a casa una obra vibrante o un pequeño regalo hecho por ellos mismos, como recuerdo de su imaginación en acción.

title: Are You A Librarian? The Untold Story Of Black Librarians with Rodney Freeman
description:
Date: Tuesday, March 17, 2026
Time: 5:00pm - 8:00pm
Presenter: Rodney Freeman, Terry B. Hill
Location: Earl A Morgan Auditorium

TO REGISTER, PLEASE CLICK THIS LINK HERE

Join us for a powerful screening followed by a live panel conversation with filmmaker Rodney Freeman and Terry B. Hill, Library Director. Together, they’ll unpack the film’s themes of Black history, intellectual freedom, and the fight against erasure—exploring how libraries, literacy, and public institutions play a critical role in social justice and representation.

Are You a Librarian? The Untold Story of Black Librarians explores the overlooked legacy of Black librarians—from slavery and segregation to today’s fights over book bans and intellectual freedom. Through interviews, archival footage, and expert insight, the film highlights how Black librarians turned underfunded spaces into powerful centers of culture, education, and community.

Rodney Freeman is a library professional with over 15 years of experience across academic, public, and government libraries. He is the founder of Reminisce Preservation, an organization dedicated to helping communities preserve, share, and protect their histories.

Terry B. Hill is the Director of the Jersey City Free Public Library, New Jersey’s largest municipal library system. With over 30 years of experience in public and academic libraries, he is committed to advancing literacy, digital equity, and community access through libraries.

🎟️ Free & open to the public.

Come reflect, learn, and celebrate Black History Month

title: Fun Fridays 2026 at Communipaw Branch
description:

Location: Communipaw Branch

Players must know how to use controllers, listen, and share with others.

Ages 5 and up.

  • January: 16 & 30
  • February: 13 & 27
  • March: 13 & 27
  • April: 10 & 24
  • May: 8 & 22
  • June: 5 & 19

👧 Ages: Children 5 years old through teens

Bring your friends and make Fridays the best day of the week!
